info.title: Greenlight — Multi-Platform Prompt & Channel Gateway
info.description:
Self-hosted HTTP gateway for human-in-the-loop AI agents across Telegram, Slack, Teams, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp, and Messenger.

**Path verbs:** `POST …/new` creates a durable resource (channel or prompt). `POST …/send` delivers chat text on a MESSAGE channel only.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Database-backed API key with scoped permissions. Bootstrap from GREENLIGHT_API_KEY env on first boot when api_keys is empty.

channel_id.description: Single-channel send. Mutually exclusive with broadcast_group and broadcast_group_id.

broadcast_group_id.description: Enterprise: send to a saved broadcast group.

allow_text.description: Allow free-text replies matching ID:#N patterns.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL for signed answer callbacks.

correlation_id.description: Short human-readable label for logs and dashboards.

callback_data.description: Optional JSON object or array (max 8192 bytes). Echoed in the signed answer callback.

callback_headers.description: Optional outbound HTTP headers (max 4096 bytes). Not returned on GET; use callback_headers_configured.

callback_data.description: Workflow state echoed in answer callbacks.

callback_headers_configured.description: Whether outbound callback_headers were set at create (values not exposed).

broadcast_batch_id.description: Fan-out batch id linking rows from one multi-channel send.

broadcast_group_id.description: Saved broadcast group when sent via broadcast_group_id.

callback_headers.description: Outbound HTTP headers for message.created forwards (MESSAGE only).
